name: autocomplete
description: Inline code suggestions (ghost text) in every language from a small code model on your machine: llama.cpp with Qwen2.5-Coder, downloaded when you ask, a .gguf of your own, or Ollama. Nothing leaves the machine.

settings.label: Model server
settings.description: local: llama.cpp, which the extension downloads and runs. ollama: a model Ollama serves. off: no suggestions.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: For local: 0.5b (0.5 GB, fast on any CPU), 1.5b (1.6 GB, better) or 3b (3.3 GB, best, slow without a GPU), all Qwen2.5-Coder. Or the path or URL of a .gguf of your own that fills in the middle.

settings.label: CPU threads
settings.description: For local: how many threads llama.cpp uses. Empty: its own choice.

settings.label: Ollama model
settings.description: A code model that fills in the middle: qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, starcoder2:3b, codegemma:2b... Pull it with ollama pull first.

settings.label: Wait before asking (ms)
settings.description: How long typing must pause before a suggestion is asked for.

settings.label: Languages without suggestions
settings.description: Comma-separated language ids, such as markdown, plaintext.
